messages.author: ae36205664915f39
messages.subject: DataTable Filter/Search Box Time-out
parts:
The searchbox included for DataTables in the DT package is slow and/or times out when searching larger data sets. I have set the searchDelay to 2000ms, but this does not help in all cases.

Any suggestions on how to prevent the time-out and improve search performance?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DataTable Filter/Search Box Time-out
parts:
Being slow and timeout are two different problems. Did you see both
problems? What does the latter problem look like?

The speed is up to R, and I guess there isn't much we can improve at
the moment, unless you provide your own server-side processing
function -- see the filter argument of ?dataTableAjax (this will
require you to understand the low-level details of DataTables).

Timeout may be configured by Ajax settings. I have never seen a
timeout yet, so it will be nice if you can provide a minimal
reproducible example (feel free to use simulated data).

Regards,
Yihui
